observation.subject: POST /orders
observation.sentence: `POST /orders`: warm median 1.2 ms over 199 requests; Handler, other work 60 %, Response write 20 %, Other filters 20 %. Median CPU 1.2 ms and 33 KB allocated per request. First request 51 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in the handler outside recorded calls: run Profile resources to see the route's hottest frames.
Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: 199 requests sent Kafka messages: a Kafka send is timed until the broker acknowledges it asynchronously, which the handler does not wait for, so its time is not counted as Message sends.

This application's database access is not recorded: BootUI records JDBC statements through a traced DataSource, not R2DBC or reactive SQL clients, and no traced DataSource is in use. Its SQL and connection evidence is not counted.
observation.unlistedReason: Its warm median is under 20 ms, and authorization takes under 20 % of its time and under 50 decisions a request, so it is not prominent.
